in_sanskrit.name: Velu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Shining One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Velu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Velu is derived from the Tamil word 'Vel' which means 'shining'. Velu is a name for those who are believed to shine brightly in their own unique way. It is a name that symbolizes radiance, joy, and positivity.
